config:
{"config.yaml":"healthCheckTimeout: 900
logToStdout: both
apiKeys:
- ${env.LLAMA_API_TOKEN}
models:
  humanlike-2.0:
    name: humanlike-2.0
    cmd: /opt/llama/llama-server --model /models/humanlike/Qwen3.8-27B-Humanlike-Chat-IQ4_XS.gguf
      --ctx-size 32768 --parallel 1 --n-gpu-layers 99 --flash-attn on --cache-type-k
      q8_0 --cache-type-v q8_0 --jinja --host 127.0.0.1 --port ${PORT} --alias humanlike-2.0
      --threads 8 --threads-batch 8 --batch-size 512 --ubatch-size 128 --temp 1.0
      --top-p 0.95 --top-k 20 --min-p 0.0 --reasoning off
    env:
    - LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/llama:/opt/llama/cuda:/usr/local/nvidia/lib64:/usr/local/nvidia/lib
    metadata:
      max_model_len: 32768
      max_tokens: 8192
      reasoning: true
      input:
      - text
  orca-saq2-27b:
    name: orca-saq2-27b
    cmd: /opt/orcasaq2/presets/serve.sh /models/orca ${PORT} orca-saq2-27b
    env:
    - PRESET=16gb-mtp
    - MAXLEN=150000
    - GPU_FRAC=0.92
    - MAXSEQS=4
    - MAXBATCHTOK=2048
    - BIND=127.0.0.1
    - EXTRA=--speculative-config {"method":"qwen3_next_mtp","num_speculative_tokens":2} --mamba-cache-mode align --prefix-match-unit 64
    aliases:
    - OrcaSAQ2
    - qwen3.8-27b
    metadata:
      max_model_len: 150000
      max_tokens: 32768
      reasoning: true
      input:
      - text
  gsq-rco-27b:
    name: gsq-rco-27b
    # Native per-request context; 320K is the shared pool for two sessions.
    # IQ3_S non-MTP weights, text-only, no speculative drafter.
    cmd: /opt/gsq/llama-server --model /models/gsq/Qwen3.8-27B-GSQ-RCO-IQ3_S.gguf
      --ctx-size 320000 --parallel 2 --kv-unified --kv-unified-per-slot 262144
      --no-context-shift --no-cache-idle-slots --fit off --n-gpu-layers 999 --flash-attn on
      --cache-type-k q8_0 --cache-type-v q8_0 --jinja
      --host 127.0.0.1 --port ${PORT} --alias gsq-rco-27b
      --threads 8 --threads-batch 8 --batch-size 2048 --ubatch-size 512
      --cache-ram 8192 --temp 1.0 --top-p 0.95 --top-k 20 --min-p 0.0
      --reasoning-effort medium
    env:
    - LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/gsq:/opt/gsq/cuda:/usr/local/nvidia/lib64:/usr/local/nvidia/lib
    - GGML_CUDA_NO_PINNED=1
    metadata:
      max_model_len: 262144
      max_tokens: 32768
      reasoning: true
      input:
      - text
  clef:
    name: clef
    unlisted: true
    cmd: python3 /opt/clef/server.py --model /models/clef --port ${PORT}
    metadata:
      max_model_len: 16384
      max_tokens: 0
      input:
      - text
"}
